stem.en: All the mitochondria are removed from a eukaryotic cell. What do you expect to happen?

text.en: The nucleus releases the energy from food instead.

feedback.en: The nucleus holds the DNA. It does not release energy from food.

text.en: The cell makes more ATP, because it now has more space.

feedback.en: ATP is made in mitochondria, so the supply falls.

text.en: The cell goes on as before by using the food it has stored.

feedback.en: Stored food is only useful if its energy can be released.

text.en: Energy for most activities stops, and the cell dies.

feedback.en: Yes. Most cell activities depend on the energy mitochondria supply.

explanation.en: Mitochondria supply the energy for most cell activities. Without them those activities stop, and the cell cannot stay alive.

hints.en: What do mitochondria supply, and which activities need it?
